investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: a plain curl GET of the venue's own official homepage directly contains 8 schema.org Event JSON-LD blocks (server-rendered, no JS execution needed to read them). ingestion/json-ld/'s existing filterMusicEventNodes() honestly separates genuine named-act music nights from a non-music community assembly.

probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of https://ladeskomunal.coop/ directly exposed 8 real schema.org Event JSON-LD blocks with explicit dates and, on 6 of them, named performers/acts — no browser/headless escalation was needed.

venue_reference: La Deskomunal (live music/cultural space + restaurant, Sants, Barcelona)

identity.notes: Official identity confirmed directly from the retained evidence at https://ladeskomunal.coop/.

site_classification.platform: WordPress + a calendar/events plugin emitting schema.org Event JSON-LD directly on the homepage.

title.notes: Each Event node's own 'name'. This venue is a mixed cultural/restaurant space (one sampled record was a community assembly meeting, no music) — this package's collector applies ingestion/json-ld/'s existing filterMusicEventNodes() to keep only genuine named-act music nights (e.g. 'FESTES DE SANTS: LaBulla', 'SENSA YUMA + NAFRA + DJ NAFRAT & DJ ROBEER'), never guessing the assembly into 'music'.

start_date.notes: Each Event node's own 'startDate', a plain 'YYYY-MM-DD' calendar date — DATE_ONLY.

time.notes: startDate carries a date only, no time-of-day.

end.notes: An 'endDate' is present on some but not all sampled nodes.

venue_location.notes: Each Event node's own 'location.name' names this single physical venue — resolved by source_id, matching this project's existing single-venue JSON-LD pattern.

source_record_id.notes: Each Event node's own 'url' (its own permalink) — used as the stable identifier, matching this project's existing antilla-bcn-barcelona/moog-barcelona precedent.

price.notes: An 'offers.price' field is present on some records; not consistently populated across the sample.

reasons: acquisition_class JSON_LD_EVENT, a resolved supported class.
A CONFIRMED public data path retained (8 real Event nodes observed live at proof time, 6 passing the existing music-relevance filter).
title and start_date both PROVEN, directly stated by the source.
source_record_id PROVEN via the node's own stable permalink URL.
recommended_family JSON_LD — completely reuses ingestion/json-ld/ unchanged, no new module needed at all.

evidence.description: The venue's own real, live homepage HTML, containing 8 real schema.org Event JSON-LD blocks.
evidence.method: curl (plain HTTP GET, descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser)

evidence.description: This package's own offline test suite (tests/deskomunal.test.mjs) re-parses the retained evidence above with ingestion/json-ld/ (unchanged) and asserts the exact music-relevance filter outcome recorded above.
